response.sql: WITH qty AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS q FROM Order_Items), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(q) AS avg_qty FROM qty WHERE q IS NOT NULL GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS base FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.base AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.base IS NULL), (p.avg_qty - b.base) DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The database is SQLite, and product_quantity holds numeric text such that NULL or blank/whitespace-only values are the missing values. Non-numeric text would be cast to 0 by this query.

Each order's average is an unweighted mean of its non-missing product_quantity values, and the baseline is an unweighted mean of those per-order averages across orders that have at least one valid quantity. The baseline is NULL, so no rows are returned, when no order has a valid quantity.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat any product_quantity that is not a plain non-negative number (for example, text like 'a few') as missing instead of casting it to 0.
alternatives.sql: WITH qty AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(CASE WHEN TRIM(product_quantity) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND TRIM(product_quantity) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' THEN TRIM(product_quantity) END AS REAL) AS q FROM Order_Items), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(q) AS avg_qty FROM qty WHERE q IS NOT NULL GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS base FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.base AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.base IS NULL), (p.avg_qty - b.base) DESC LIMIT 10;
